Thanks again for the discovery call yesterday. We agreed it would be helpful to run a focused technical deep-dive to walk through how Redwood would fit into ACME’s inference pipeline and to validate networking, data flow, and security constraints.

Proposed agenda (30–45 minutes):

- 20 min: architecture walkthrough (serving runtime, routing, KV cache behavior)
- 10 min: integration concerns (VPC peering, encryption, audit logs)

I’m available for a session next week — please pick from these slots (all PT):
- Tue Mar 17, 10:00–10:45am PT
- Tue Mar 17, 2:00–2:45pm PT
- Wed Mar 18, 9:00–9:45am PT

If none work, happy to follow your calendar or send a Calendly link. I’ll have Rishi (solutions architect) join to handle architecture questions and Neha from security for the compliance items.

Attaching a short agenda and our standard pre-deep-dive checklist. Calendar invite to follow once we lock a time.
